applied.quote: The VA funding fee is a one-time charge of 1.25% to 3.3% of the loan amount, typically rolled into the loan balance.
applied.replacement: The VA funding fee on a purchase loan is 1.25% to 3.3% of the loan amount.
applied.why: SOURCE gives 1.25%-3.3% of loan amount; not one-time or rolled in

applied.quote: It funds the VA guarantee program so it costs taxpayers nothing.
applied.why: SOURCE states no purpose of the fee or taxpayer cost

applied.quote: Veterans with a service-connected disability rating of 10% or higher are completely exempt, saving $4,375 to $11,550 on a typical $350,000 loan.
applied.replacement: Veterans who receive VA compensation for a service-connected disability are exempt, which on a $350,000 loan means not paying $4,375 to $11,550.
applied.why: SOURCE says VA disability compensation, no 10% rating or typical loan

applied.quote: Purple Heart recipients and surviving spouses of veterans who died in service or from a service-connected disability are also exempt.
applied.replacement: Purple Heart recipients on active duty and surviving spouses receiving DIC are also exempt.
applied.why: SOURCE says Purple Heart (active duty) and surviving spouses receiving DIC
